I read the plate as a square dinner plate of about 26 cm, though it is cropped in the frame. The three cheese pizza pieces are each roughly 8–10 cm across and about 1–1.5 cm thick.

- Piece 1 (left, rectangular): about 8 x 9 cm, around 55 g.
- Piece 2 (top, wedge): about 9 x 10 cm, around 50 g.
- Piece 3 (bottom right, partly cropped): about 10 x 10 cm, around 65 g.

The three pieces total about 170 g. I count the cheese and crust together as one item because they can't be separated visually.
